odd_even_process_pairs.even_uncertainty_reduced: Reduced: established from executed, independently reproduced evidence that the momentum edge is cost-robust under the repository's realistic (1x) and conservative (2x) cost models on the 10-asset universe (6/6 robust assets unchanged; per-fold drag ~1e-5..1e-4). Also reduced: the mechanism (low candidate turnover from a stable momentum sign) and the null-turnover asymmetry are now measured and documented, so future cost tests will not mis-read a widening candidate-null gap as candidate weakness. Not eliminated: the result is conditional on one cost family and one mechanical rebalance convention, and remains exploratory simulation, not live evidence.

validated_information_gained.uncertainty_reduced: Reduced: established from durable evidence that the frontier-first selector yields a clean, non-duplicate ordering of decisive, independently-verified frontier closures (six consecutive cells), whereas the prior opportunistic selection produced a documented UNVERIFIED process delta and no operative frontier. Not eliminated: the selector's isolated causal share remains unresolved because infrastructure maturation coincided with adoption and no counterfactual is available; this residual is recorded rather than hidden.
